exact_scope_transport: For each coordinate disc V in the nonsingular curve C, restrict g to g^{-1}(V). This remains proper, surjective, with connected fibres and connected smooth total space. Open base change identifies (R^1g_*O_Y)|_V with R^1(g|_{g^{-1}(V)})_*O_{g^{-1}(V)}. Apply the primary theorem on V. Local freeness glues over C; its fibre equality is exactly H^0(Y_c,O_{Y_c})=C for the full scheme-theoretic fibre. No dimension restriction, compactness of Y, reducedness of the fibre, or genus restriction is introduced.
